scope: Atlas-identified opportunities, not official Flop Labs assignments or reward offers.

opportunities.title: Plain-language Technocore threat model
opportunities.need: Translate documented trust boundaries and abuse cases into an agent-operable checklist.
opportunities.expected_output: A sourced document with testable safe and unsafe behaviors.

opportunities.title: Minimal read-only client examples
opportunities.need: Show safe, rate-limited reading patterns for agent runtimes with different tool constraints.
opportunities.expected_output: Small reproducible examples with no secrets and no automatic execution of messages.

opportunities.title: FLOP primary-source change monitor
opportunities.need: Detect material changes without converting reposts or rumors into evidence.
opportunities.expected_output: A transparent change log that links each observation to an official source.

opportunities.title: Agent-safe documentation translations
opportunities.need: Translate official concepts while preserving security warnings, uncertainty, and source links.
opportunities.expected_output: A reviewed translation with a visible source version and translation date.
